summary: Legend Biotech, a foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) on September 14, 2026, furnishing an updated clinical pipeline chart as Exhibit 99.1, signed by interim CEO Alan Bash. The exhibit lists CARVYKTI (BCMA) programs with Johnson & Johnson/Janssen, including CARTITUDE-5 and -6 in NDMM, plus early-stage autologous, allogeneic, and in-vivo candidates, several partnered with Novartis. No transaction, securities offering, ownership stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is ordinary pipeline disclosure, not a special situation; watch for future clinical data or partnership updates, not deal terms.
